# harness-golden-1780571253761
tags: golden-path, harness, e2e

A harness-seeded skill for the golden-path E2E test. This skill demonstrates correct sidecar ingestion, graph rebuild, and retrieval for the harness tracer bullet.

## Procedures
- Seed a skill via the sidecar volume writer
- Approve the pending file to trigger graph-builder pickup
- Verify the mcp-server serves the updated graph version

## Conventions
- Always use unique slugs to prevent cross-run dedup
- Remove seeded skills after the test to keep the volume clean
